Dado pessoal identifica alguém (nome, CP: Personal data identifies someone (name, CPF, phone number, conversation). Sensitive data includes health, religion, biometrics, among others (LGPD, art. 5). Sensitive data calls for extra care (art. 11).
Todo uso de dado pessoal precisa de uma: Any use of personal data needs one of the grounds in art. 7 (contract, consent, legitimate interest...). And only what is necessary for the purpose (art. 6, necessity). You point out the absence; the legal team decides the basis.
Qual fornecedor recebe e em que país o s: Which vendor receives it and in which country the server is located. Data going outside Brazil is an international transfer (arts. 33 to 36). A common route is the standard clauses of ANPD Resolution CD/ANPD No. 19/2024.
Existe contrato ou termo de tratamento d: Is there a contract or data handling agreement (DPA)? Does it state retention, subprocessors, security, and whether the data is used for training? A free personal plan usually has none of this.
Quanto tempo o dado fica no fornecedor,: How long the data stays with the vendor, whether it becomes model training, and how to delete it. If the company can't answer, it has lost control of the data.
Você aponta o risco com evidência. Dizer: You point out the risk with evidence. Saying whether the use is illegal is a legal opinion: that stays with the company's lawyer.
Vazou dado pessoal? A LGPD prevê comunic: Was personal data leaked? The LGPD (Brazil's data protection law) requires notifying the ANPD and the data subjects when there is relevant risk (art. 48). This is incident response: tell the owner the same day and point to the legal team.
